title: Google’s patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment’s future

title: FCC approves SpaceX plan to put AI data centers in space
text: The FCC dismissed some of the key concerns raised by opponents, including potential threats to scientific research, because the agency determined they fell outside its regulatory authority.

title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York
text: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years as new research from Common Sense Media reveals troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.
